name: app-review-scraper
description: A Claude Code skill: download every public user review for a mobile app (or several apps) from the iOS App Store and Google Play, store it locally as normalized JSON/CSV, and run a first-pass analysis (rating distribution, trend over time, complaint themes). Uses the fast no-credential paths first (Apple's public RSS JSON, google-play-scraper) and only falls back to slow browser scraping as a last resort.
